summary: Tested Status page RSS feed + component embed badges (iteration 50). Backend: /api/status/feed.xml returns 200 with application/rss+xml, well-formed RSS 2.0 XML with channel title 'Stitches Status', link to /status, atom:link rel=self pointing to feed.xml, and 5 <item> entries each containing <title>, <link> to /status/<component>, <guid>, <pubDate>, <description>. /api/status/badge.svg?component=email returns 200 image/svg+xml (849 bytes). Frontend: on /status the footer 'Subscribe via RSS' link (data-testid=status-rss-link) href correctly ends with /api/status/feed.xml. On /status/email the component-embed section is present with live badge preview (naturalWidth=159), HTML + Markdown snippets both containing /api/status/badge.svg?component=email and /status/email, and both copy buttons work — clipboard contents verified via navigator.clipboard.readText() and 'Markdown snippet copied' toast visible. Regression testids present: component-window-24h/7d/90d, component-daily-chart, component-incidents, component-back (href=/status). Verified same behavior on /status/calls (embed section renders with component=calls in snippet).
test_credentials: Not required for these public endpoints.
context_for_next_testing_agent: RSS feed at /api/status/feed.xml and per-component embed (HTML + Markdown snippet + preview badge) on /status/:key are fully functional. Email is legitimately degraded in this env (no provider key) — expected. 24h/7d/90d windows show 0% for email because of continuous degraded incidents; this is expected, not a bug. Clipboard permissions must be granted with context.grant_permissions(['clipboard-read','clipboard-write']) before testing copy buttons — otherwise a 'Copy failed' toast is a permissions artifact, not a real defect.
